title: "RBP binding-site annotation prototype (revision/file-changes/04-5-rbp-binding-sites.Rmd.md)"
output: html_document
---

```{r, setup}
# Prototype for revision/file-changes/04-5-rbp-binding-sites.Rmd.md, Step 1.
#
# Builds two artifacts used downstream (05-create-aggregated-dt.Rmd,
# 09-1-ml-local.R):
#   - processed_data/rbp_per_event.rds : ID -> list of nearby RBP names
#   - processed_data/rbp_gene_ids.rds  : rbp_name -> gencode.v29 gene_id
#
# RBP identity source: POSTAR3 human CLIPdb (data/human.txt.gz), note that this cannot be redistributed (POSTAR3 license) and has to be downloaded separately. The file is a concatenation of all POSTAR3 CLIPdb tables (eCLIP, iCLIP, PAR-CLIP, HITS-CLIP) with the following columns:
#   1 seqnames, 2 start(0-based), 3 end, 4 peak_id, 5 strand,
#   6 rbp name (or literal "RBP_occupancy" for PIP-seq rows with no
#     RBP identity -> dropped), 7 technique, 8 cell_line, 9 accession, 10 score
# ~220 distinct RBPs are CLIP-profiled in this file; that set (not a
# separate ATtRACT/curated list) is used directly as the RBP universe
# for this prototype.
set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))

# Per-filter invocation (matches 02-2/02-3/03/05): one transcript_filter per run,
# selected by TRANSCRIPT_FILTER env (Snakemake wildcard); interactive falls back
# to the primary filter. Step 1 artifacts + Step 2 feature tables are all scoped
# to this filter's events + normalised expression.
this_transcript_filter <- Sys.getenv(
  "TRANSCRIPT_FILTER",
  unset = getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_PRIMARY_FILTER", "biotype_filtered")
)

dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sanity_csv <- "qc/sanity_summary.csv"
append_sanity <- function(check_name, status, value, threshold, notes = "") {
  new_row <- data.table(
    check_name = check_name,
    status = status,
    value = value,
    threshold = threshold,
    notes = notes
  )
  if (file.exists(sanity_csv)) {
    # upsert by check_name: drop any prior row for this check before writing
    # the new one, so sanity_summary.csv doesn't accumulate stale/duplicate
    # rows across reruns (append=TRUE never truncated -> the file only grew).
    existing <- fread(sanity_csv)
    existing <- existing[check_name != new_row$check_name]
    fwrite(rbind(existing, new_row, fill = TRUE), sanity_csv)
  } else {
    fwrite(new_row, sanity_csv)
  }
}

# matches the 200bp splice-site-proximal window already used for ChIP
# features in 03-prepare-aggregation.Rmd's make_window() (5up/5down/3up/3down)
window_bp <- 200L
```


```{r, load-postar3-binding-sites}
postar_dt <- fread(
  cmd = "zcat data/human.txt.gz | awk -F'\t' '$6 != \"RBP_occupancy\"'",
  header = FALSE,
  select = 1:6,
  col.names = c("seqnames", "start0", "end", "peak_id", "strand", "rbp")
)

n_postar_raw <- nrow(postar_dt) # after RBP_occupancy drop, before merge
n_rbp_raw <- uniqueN(postar_dt$rbp)
append_sanity(
  "postar3_rbp_universe_size",
  ifelse(n_rbp_raw >= 150 & n_rbp_raw <= 300, "PASS", "WARN"),
  n_rbp_raw,
  220,
  "distinct CLIP-profiled RBP names after dropping generic 'RBP_occupancy' rows"
)

# BED is 0-based half-open -> GRanges is 1-based closed
postar_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = postar_dt$seqnames,
  ranges = IRanges(start = postar_dt$start0 + 1L, end = postar_dt$end),
  strand = postar_dt$strand,
  rbp = postar_dt$rbp
)
rm(postar_dt)
gc()

# CLIP peaks are massively redundant across experiments/cell lines; merge
# overlapping intervals per RBP before findOverlaps to shrink the object.
peaks_per_rbp_raw <- table(postar_gr$rbp)
postar_gr <- unlist(reduce(split(postar_gr, postar_gr$rbp)))
postar_gr$rbp <- names(postar_gr)
names(postar_gr) <- NULL
peaks_per_rbp_merged <- table(postar_gr$rbp)

cat(
  "POSTAR3 rows retained (RBP-named):",
  n_postar_raw,
  "\n",
  "-> merged intervals:",
  length(postar_gr),
  sprintf("(%.1f%% reduction)\n", 100 * (1 - length(postar_gr) / n_postar_raw))
)
```


```{r, viz-postar3-top-rbps, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# viz 1: which RBPs have the most binding evidence in POSTAR3 (pre-overlap;
# a sanity check on the input data itself, not yet event-specific).
top20 <- sort(peaks_per_rbp_merged, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
draw_top_rbps <- function() {
  par(mar = c(8, 4, 4, 2))
  barplot(
    top20,
    las = 2,
    col = "steelblue",
    main = "Top 20 RBPs by merged POSTAR3 interval count",
    ylab = "merged binding intervals (genome-wide)"
  )
}
draw_top_rbps() # inline, alongside the saved PDF below
pdf("qc/distributions/rbp_postar3_top_rbps.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
draw_top_rbps()
dev.off()
```


```{r, event-coordinates}
event_annotations_dt <- fread(sprintf(
  "processed_data/event_annotations_dt_%s.csv.gz",
  this_transcript_filter
))
# per-filter file carries a single transcript_filter; stratification below
# collapses to one stratum (kept general so the code is filter-agnostic).

# event_id encodes coords as "<gene_id>;<TYPE>:<chr>:<coords>:<strand>" (SUPPA2
# format: SE = gene;SE:chr:e1-s2:e2-s3:strand, e2=exon body [s2,e2];
# RI = gene;RI:chr:e1:s2-e2:s3:strand, retained intron body = [s2,e2]).
# NB: taking min/max of ALL 4 numbers (e1..s3) instead would span both full
# flanking introns (median ~6.4kb, up to >1Mb) rather than just the regulated
# exon/intron -> confirmed via a test run that inflated median RBPs/event to
# 34 by pulling in binding sites from the entire neighboring introns, not
# just the ±200bp flank the plan intends. Must extract the inner [s2, e2]
# body specifically, per event type.
extract_core <- function(event_id, event_type) {
  coord_part <- vapply(
    strsplit(event_id, ";", fixed = TRUE),
    `[`,
    character(1),
    2
  )
  coord_part <- sub("^[A-Z0-9]+:[^:]+:", "", coord_part) # drop "TYPE:chr:"
  coord_part <- sub(":[+-]$", "", coord_part) # drop ":strand"
  segments <- strsplit(coord_part, ":")
  core <- mapply(
    function(segs, type) {
      if (type == "SE") {
        # segs = c("e1-s2", "e2-s3") -> core = [s2, e2]
        s2 <- as.numeric(strsplit(segs[1], "-")[[1]][2])
        e2 <- as.numeric(strsplit(segs[2], "-")[[1]][1])
      } else if (type == "RI") {
        # segs = c("e1", "s2-e2", "s3") -> core = [s2, e2]
        pair <- as.numeric(strsplit(segs[2], "-")[[1]])
        s2 <- pair[1]
        e2 <- pair[2]
      } else {
        stop("extract_core: unhandled Event Type: ", type)
      }
      c(s2, e2)
    },
    segments,
    event_type
  )
  list(start_core = core[1, ], end_core = core[2, ])
}
event_annotations_dt[,
  c("start_core", "end_core") := extract_core(event_id, `Event Type`)
]
event_annotations_dt[, core_width := end_core - start_core]

# All analysis below is stratified by (Event Type, transcript_filter) -- the
# same granularity 04-2-chip-signal-sanity.Rmd uses and the granularity
# 09-1-ml-local.R models at (transcripts is a superset of tsl_filtered, which
# is a superset of biotype_filtered -- same underlying genomic events under
# different annotation filters, so pooling across filters would silently
# triple-count/mix them).
strata <- unique(event_annotations_dt[, .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)])
setorder(strata, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)

# check: core width is a small exon/intron body, not a multi-kb span. SE
# core = a single exon (human median ~120-150bp); RI core = the retained
# intron itself (can be several hundred bp to a few kb, but not megabases).
for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
  this_et <- strata$`Event Type`[i]
  this_tf <- strata$transcript_filter[i]
  stratum_key <- paste(this_et, this_tf, sep = "_")
  sub_dt <- event_annotations_dt[
    `Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf
  ]
  threshold <- if (this_et == "SE") 5000 else 50000
  bad_width <- sub_dt[core_width > threshold]
  append_sanity(
    paste0("rbp_event_core_width_plausible_", stratum_key),
    ifelse(nrow(bad_width) == 0, "PASS", "WARN"),
    nrow(bad_width),
    0,
    sprintf(
      "%s: events with implausibly large core width (>%d bp): %d/%d",
      stratum_key,
      threshold,
      nrow(bad_width),
      nrow(sub_dt)
    )
  )
}
```


```{r, viz-core-width, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# viz 2: core (exon/intron body) width distribution, per (Event Type,
# transcript_filter) stratum -- the quantity the ±200bp window is actually
# built around. Directly documents the bug found/fixed above: this should
# look like exon/intron lengths, not the multi-kb-to-Mb flanking-intron-
# inclusive span a naive min/max parse of the event_id would produce.
draw_core_width <- function() {
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
    this_et <- strata$`Event Type`[i]
    this_tf <- strata$transcript_filter[i]
    vals <- event_annotations_dt[
      `Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf,
      core_width
    ]
    hist(
      pmin(vals, quantile(vals, 0.99)), # clip extreme tail for a readable axis
      breaks = 50,
      col = "steelblue",
      border = "white",
      main = paste(this_et, this_tf, "\n(99th pctile clipped)"),
      xlab = "width (bp)"
    )
  }
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}
draw_core_width() # inline, alongside the saved PDF below
pdf("qc/distributions/rbp_event_core_width.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
draw_core_width()
dev.off()
```


```{r, event-overlap}
events_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = event_annotations_dt$seqnames,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = event_annotations_dt$start_core - window_bp,
    end = event_annotations_dt$end_core + window_bp
  ),
  strand = event_annotations_dt$strand,
  ID = event_annotations_dt$ID
)

# ignore.strand = FALSE: RBPs bind single-stranded, strand-specific pre-mRNA,
# and modern CLIP (eCLIP/iCLIP/PAR-CLIP, POSTAR3's sources) is stranded — the
# peak strand IS the bound RNA's strand. A peak on the opposite strand at this
# locus is a different (antisense) transcript, not evidence this RBP binds the
# event's pre-mRNA. Requiring the CLIP-peak strand to match the event's gene
# strand drops those antisense false positives. (The earlier ignore.strand=TRUE
# treated the locus as double-stranded DNA — wrong for an RNA-binding protein.)
hits <- findOverlaps(events_gr, postar_gr, ignore.strand = FALSE)
rbp_per_event <- data.table(
  ID = events_gr$ID[queryHits(hits)],
  rbp = postar_gr$rbp[subjectHits(hits)]
)[, .(rbp = list(unique(rbp))), by = ID]

saveRDS(
  rbp_per_event,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/rbp_per_event_%s.rds",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)

# n_rbp per event, 0 for events with no overlap (rbp_per_event only has rows
# with >=1 hit) -- needed so per-stratum medians/coverage aren't biased
# upward by silently dropping the zero-hit events from the denominator.
event_annotations_dt[, n_rbp := 0L]
event_annotations_dt[
  rbp_per_event[, .(ID, n_rbp_hit = lengths(rbp))],
  on = "ID",
  n_rbp := i.n_rbp_hit
]

for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
  this_et <- strata$`Event Type`[i]
  this_tf <- strata$transcript_filter[i]
  stratum_key <- paste(this_et, this_tf, sep = "_")
  sub_dt <- event_annotations_dt[
    `Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf
  ]

  frac_with_rbp <- sub_dt[, mean(n_rbp > 0)]
  append_sanity(
    paste0("rbp_event_coverage_", stratum_key),
    ifelse(frac_with_rbp > 0.5, "PASS", "WARN"),
    frac_with_rbp,
    0.5,
    sprintf(
      "%s: %d/%d events have >=1 nearby RBP",
      stratum_key,
      sub_dt[, sum(n_rbp > 0)],
      nrow(sub_dt)
    )
  )

  # check: per plan §"Filter by binding site first" -- should be a modest
  # per-event feature count (~20-100), not the full ~220-RBP universe (no
  # filtering happened) and not near-zero (window/overlap logic broken).
  med_n <- median(sub_dt$n_rbp)
  append_sanity(
    paste0("rbp_per_event_count_plausible_", stratum_key),
    ifelse(med_n >= 2 & med_n <= 150, "PASS", "WARN"),
    med_n,
    "[2, 150]",
    sprintf(
      "%s: median %d, mean %.1f, max %d RBPs/event",
      stratum_key,
      med_n,
      mean(sub_dt$n_rbp),
      max(sub_dt$n_rbp)
    )
  )
}
```


```{r, viz-rbp-per-event, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# viz 3: distribution of RBP-count-per-event, per (Event Type,
# transcript_filter) stratum -- the plan's central design decision (filter
# by binding site first) is only doing useful work if this is meaningfully
# less than the full ~220-RBP universe for most events.
draw_rbp_per_event <- function() {
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
    this_et <- strata$`Event Type`[i]
    this_tf <- strata$transcript_filter[i]
    vals <- event_annotations_dt[
      `Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf,
      n_rbp
    ]
    hist(
      vals,
      breaks = 50,
      col = "darkorange",
      border = "white",
      main = paste(this_et, this_tf),
      xlab = "number of distinct RBPs"
    )
    abline(v = median(vals), col = "red", lty = 2)
    legend(
      "topright",
      legend = sprintf("median = %d", median(vals)),
      lty = 2,
      col = "red",
      bty = "n"
    )
  }
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}
draw_rbp_per_event() # inline, alongside the saved PDF below
pdf("qc/distributions/rbp_count_per_event.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
draw_rbp_per_event()
dev.off()
```


```{r, rbp-gene-mapping}
# Map RBP names -> gencode.v29 gene_id (same annotation used in
# 03-prepare-aggregation.Rmd) for the gene_quants join in 05.
all_rbp_names <- unique(unlist(rbp_per_event$rbp))

gtf_genes <- fread(
  cmd = "awk -F'\t' '$3==\"gene\"' splicing_analysis/gencode.v29.annotation.gtf",
  header = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  select = 9
)
gene_lookup <- data.table(
  gene_id = sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', "\\1", gtf_genes$V9),
  gene_name = sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', "\\1", gtf_genes$V9)
)

rbp_gene_ids <- gene_lookup[gene_name %in% all_rbp_names]
setnames(rbp_gene_ids, "gene_name", "rbp_name")

# Manual alias map for POSTAR3 RBP names not present in gencode.v29 under
# that exact string. Confirmed these are naming mismatches, not missing
# genes or an Ensembl-version issue -- gencode.v29 has all 8 target genes,
# just under a different symbol:
#   U2AF65 -> U2AF2    protein-subunit name for the U2AF2 gene
#   HNRNPH -> HNRNPH1  ambiguous shorthand; H1 is the dominant paralog
#   DDX3   -> DDX3X    ambiguous vs Y-linked DDX3Y; X is the standard pick
#   SMN    -> SMN1     ambiguous vs paralog SMN2; SMN1 is the disease-relevant copy
#   TDP43  -> TARDBP   old protein nickname (TARDBP itself already matches
#                      separately under its own POSTAR3 label -- this adds
#                      a second, fully redundant rbp_TDP43 feature pointing
#                      at the same gene_id; harmless, lasso will shrink one)
#   UNR    -> CSDE1    old protein nickname
#   ACI    -> ACIN1    "Acinus"; confirmed via GSE81460 iCLIP study title
#   SDOS   -> NUDT16L1 "Syndesmos"; confirmed via GSE118049 iCLIP study title
rbp_alias_map <- c(
  U2AF65 = "U2AF2",
  HNRNPH = "HNRNPH1",
  DDX3 = "DDX3X",
  SMN = "SMN1",
  TDP43 = "TARDBP",
  UNR = "CSDE1",
  ACI = "ACIN1",
  SDOS = "NUDT16L1"
)
aliased_names <- intersect(names(rbp_alias_map), all_rbp_names)
if (length(aliased_names) > 0) {
  aliased_rows <- gene_lookup[gene_name %in% rbp_alias_map[aliased_names]]
  aliased_rows[,
    rbp_name := names(rbp_alias_map)[match(gene_name, rbp_alias_map)]
  ]
  aliased_rows[, gene_name := NULL]
  rbp_gene_ids <- rbind(rbp_gene_ids, aliased_rows)
}

unmatched <- setdiff(all_rbp_names, rbp_gene_ids$rbp_name)
append_sanity(
  "rbp_gene_id_mapping_complete",
  ifelse(length(unmatched) == 0, "PASS", "WARN"),
  length(unmatched),
  0,
  sprintf(
    "RBP names unmatched to gencode.v29 gene_name: %s",
    paste(unmatched, collapse = ", ")
  )
)

saveRDS(
  rbp_gene_ids,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/rbp_gene_ids_%s.rds",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)
```


```{r, rbp-expression-features}
# Step 2 (§3.4 / file-changes/04-5-rbp-binding-sites.Rmd.md): turn the genomic
# binding-site annotation (Step 1) into per-sample EXPRESSION feature tables.
#
# EXPR_COL = gene_expression_vst. RBP and spliceosome features are SINGLE-GENE
# columns (one gene's expression across samples), so they take vst — the same
# routing as the event host gene in 09-1/07 (§4.12b). getmm is reserved for the
# pooled splicing_ml host `gene_expression` (cross-gene comparability); it is
# NOT used here. vst can be negative -> downstream recipes step_normalize only,
# never log/log1p.
EXPR_COL <- "gene_expression_vst"
gene_expr <- fread(
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/gene_expression_normalised_%s.csv.gz",
    this_transcript_filter
  ),
  select = c("gene_id", "uuid", EXPR_COL)
)
setnames(gene_expr, EXPR_COL, "expr")
gene_expr[, gene_id_stripped := sub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_id)]

# per-RBP expression: rbp_name -> gene_id -> expr, version-stripped join
rbp_ids <- copy(rbp_gene_ids)[,
  gene_id_stripped := sub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_id)
]
rbp_expr <- gene_expr[
  rbp_ids,
  on = "gene_id_stripped",
  nomatch = NULL,
  allow.cartesian = TRUE
]

# --- Step 2a: RBP score (4 cols) for splicing_ml + 05 ---------------------
# Per (ID, uuid): sum/mean/max RBP expression across the RBPs binding near that
# event, PLUS rbp_n (how many distinct expressed RBPs contributed). Fixed-width
# so a pooled model can consume it (can't swap the ~220-col active subset per
# row). _mean = typical local RBP level; _max = strongest single candidate;
# _sum = total load BUT it scales with rbp_n (# binding RBPs, a per-event
# genomic constant) -> in a pooled model that is an event-identity confound, so
# rbp_n is emitted alongside to let the model separate "how many" from "how
# much each". None of these recover activator-vs-repressor direction (aggregate
# over mixed-sign RBPs) — that lives in the per-RBP wide columns (Step 2c/09-1).
# Events with no nearby RBP get no row -> 05 imputes 0 (not mean).
event_rbp_long <- rbp_per_event[, .(rbp_name = unlist(rbp)), by = ID]
# The (rbp_name)-join fans out to event x sample x nearby-RBP rows (hundreds of
# millions) BEFORE the by=.(ID,uuid) collapse — materialising it whole OOMs
# (32.6 G MaxRSS at 32 G alloc, step 18/20). (1) slim rbp_expr to the 3 columns
# the aggregation needs (drop gene_id / gene_id_stripped so fan-out rows are
# small), (2) chunk the join+aggregate over batches of events so the peak
# intermediate is ~1/n_chunks of the full cartesian, then rbind the already-
# collapsed per-batch results. Each ID lives in exactly one batch, so per-batch
# aggregation is complete -> identical to aggregating the whole join at once.
rbp_expr_slim <- rbp_expr[, .(rbp_name, uuid, expr)]
setkey(rbp_expr_slim, rbp_name)
event_ids <- unique(event_rbp_long$ID)
n_chunks <- max(1L, min(50L, ceiling(length(event_ids) / 1000L)))
id_batches <- split(event_ids, cut(seq_along(event_ids), n_chunks, labels = FALSE))
rbp_score_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(id_batches, function(id_batch) {
  rbp_expr_slim[
    event_rbp_long[ID %in% id_batch],
    on = "rbp_name",
    nomatch = NULL,
    allow.cartesian = TRUE
  ][,
    .(
      rbp_score_sum = sum(expr, na.rm = TRUE),
      rbp_score_mean = mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE),
      rbp_score_max = max(expr, na.rm = TRUE),
      rbp_n = uniqueN(rbp_name)
    ),
    by = .(ID, uuid)
  ]
}))
rbp_score_dt[, transcript_filter := this_transcript_filter]
fwrite(
  rbp_score_dt,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/rbp_score_dt_%s.csv.gz",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)

# --- Step 2b: core spliceosome factors (site-unspecific, genome-wide) ------
# Distinct from Step 2a: core machinery engages every intron via spliceosome
# assembly (no discrete CLIP motif to filter on), so these are an unfiltered,
# per-sample block kept under their own `spliceosome_` prefix. Reuse the
# gencode gene_name->gene_id lookup from Step 1.
core_spliceosome_genes <- c(
  "SF3B1",
  "U2AF1",
  "U2AF2",
  "PRPF8",
  "EFTUD2",
  "SNRNP200",
  "SNRNP70",
  "SNRPB"
)
spliceosome_gene_ids <- gene_lookup[gene_name %in% core_spliceosome_genes]
saveRDS(
  spliceosome_gene_ids,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/spliceosome_gene_ids_%s.rds",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)
spl_ids <- copy(spliceosome_gene_ids)[,
  gene_id_stripped := sub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_id)
]
spliceosome_wide <- dcast(
  gene_expr[spl_ids, on = "gene_id_stripped", nomatch = NULL],
  uuid ~ paste0("spliceosome_", gene_name),
  value.var = "expr",
  fun.aggregate = mean
)
spliceosome_wide[, transcript_filter := this_transcript_filter]
fwrite(
  spliceosome_wide,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/splicing_factor_expression_%s.csv.gz",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)

# --- Step 2c: wide per-RBP expression for 09-1 (event-filtered downstream) --
# One `rbp_<name>` column per RBP; 09-1 keeps only columns for RBPs binding the
# event being modelled. >1 gene_id can map to one rbp_name (alias rows) -> mean.
rbp_wide <- dcast(
  rbp_expr,
  uuid ~ paste0("rbp_", rbp_name),
  value.var = "expr",
  fun.aggregate = mean
)
rbp_wide[, transcript_filter := this_transcript_filter]
fwrite(
  rbp_wide,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/rbp_wide_expression_%s.csv.gz",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)

append_sanity(
  sprintf("rbp_score_events_%s", this_transcript_filter),
  "INFO",
  uniqueN(rbp_score_dt$ID),
  NA_real_,
  "events with >=1 nearby RBP that got an rbp_score row"
)
append_sanity(
  sprintf("rbp_spliceosome_genes_found_%s", this_transcript_filter),
  ifelse(
    nrow(spliceosome_gene_ids) == length(core_spliceosome_genes),
    "PASS",
    "WARN"
  ),
  nrow(spliceosome_gene_ids),
  length(core_spliceosome_genes),
  "core spliceosome genes mapped to gencode gene_id"
)
```

cat(
  "Events with >=1 nearby RBP:",
  event_annotations_dt[, sum(n_rbp > 0)],
  "/",
  nrow(event_annotations_dt),
  "\n",
  "Distinct RBPs found near any event:",
  length(all_rbp_names),
  "\n",
  "Distinct RBPs mapped to gencode.v29 gene_id:",
  nrow(rbp_gene_ids),
  "\n",
  "Median RBPs per event (overall):",
  median(event_annotations_dt$n_rbp),
  "\n"
)

knitr::kable(event_annotations_dt[,
  .(
    n_events = .N,
    events_with_rbp = sum(n_rbp > 0),
    median_n_rbp = as.numeric(median(n_rbp)),
    mean_n_rbp = round(mean(n_rbp), 1),
    max_n_rbp = max(n_rbp)
  ),
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
][order(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)])

knitr::kable(fread(sanity_csv)[grepl("^rbp_|^postar3_", check_name)])
